title: Woodfiring Extravaganza! Firing Workshop at Mendocino Art Center (soda kiln)
source_quote: Woodfiring Extravaganza! Firing Workshop; August 15 to 17 In this hands-on firing workshop, students will get the chance to load and fire both the wood-fired train kiln and the wood-fired soda kiln.
evidence_sentence: Students load and fire the wood-fired soda kiln with stacking strategies for flame flow and ash accumulation.
evidence_quote: students will get the chance to load and fire both the wood-fired train kiln and the wood-fired soda kiln. Students will learn stacking strategies to account for flame flow and ash accumulation.
summary: A hands-on soda firing workshop at Mendocino Arts Center (Mendocino, California) from August 15-17, 2026, loading and firing the wood-fired soda kiln with stoking shifts.
commitment: August 15-17 (48 hour cycle with stoking shifts)
